overall_reason: The job is checking recent deploys: the list order holds, but a second header line and uppercase tracking on every label flatten the card's header, metadata and timestamps into one texture.

score.reason: T-SQUINT reads the black DEPLOY button first but the 12px header after the 14px row titles, and T-DELETION finds a sub-header that repeats the list's count.

findings.evidence: dom-1440.json: the card title "RECENT DEPLOYS" is 12px/600, smaller than the 14px/500 row titles. The sub-header, the metadata ("MAIN · MAYA CHEN") and the timestamps ("JUST NOW", "12M AGO") are all uppercase 10px. In the squint render they form even grey bands with the title.
findings.before: Header, metadata and timestamps all in tracked 10 to 12px capitals.
findings.after: Set the title above the row titles in size or weight, and set the metadata and timestamps in sentence case.
findings.why: When the header reads after the rows, the reader finds the list before knowing what it is.

findings.evidence: The line "PRODUCTION · 3 DEPLOYS" sits between the header row and the list; the sweep's chrome_glyphs hit (SLP-010) flags its middot chain. The list below shows the three rows itself.
findings.before: A two-line header before any content.
findings.after: Delete the sub-header, or fold "Production" into the title row.
findings.why: Deleting it loses nothing, and it pushes the first record down.

strengths: Each row keeps its title and metadata as one item (title at y=100, metadata at y=120), and the timestamps share one right edge at x=670.
not_investigated: 00-contract.md is absent: no visitor mode, audience or brief overrides; judged as a single product illustration (an app component shown in a frame), with Operate-style rules for the component itself.
T-FIVE-SECOND, T-HEADINGS-READ, T-COMPOSITION-RUN, T-STOCK-ORDER and T-ANATOMY: the artifact is one composition in one 1440x900 tile, not a page with sections, a fold or a visitor job.
The label text above the frame and the plate around it belong to the viewing page, not the composition; they were not judged.
Squint render made with Pillow (GaussianBlur 8) in 03-lenses/squint/ as a viewing aid; no blur_render detector exists.
